designer_intent.description: Create a dark phonk club track focused on chopped vocal samples arranged with modern sampling techniques emphasizing dynamics and energy flow.

presetor_intent.description: Utilize presets that emphasize gritty textures, punchy drums, and vocal sample manipulation with filters and glitches.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate a club-energy drum pattern with punchy kicks, sharp snares, and syncopated hi-hats to drive rhythm and complement vocal chops.

bass_generator.brief: Create a bassline that supports the groove with low-end emphasis, fitting the dark mood and complementing drum energy.

harmony_generator.brief: Provide subtle harmonic content with dark chord progressions to support vocal focus without overpowering the mix.

melody_generator.brief: Layer instrumental melodies using chopped sample techniques that weave around vocal parts and add texture.

ai_designer.brief: Arrange the overall track structure, balancing energy curves and ensuring smooth transitions between sections focusing on vocal variation.

presetor.brief: Apply sound presets emphasizing modern chopped samples with creative filtering, glitching, and dynamic effects.

songgps.brief: Track song progression, energy flow, and enforce section structure to maintain vocal focus and club energy.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance raw channel audio ensuring clarity of vocal chops while preserving the dark, club energy atmosphere without applying final processing.
